reuse.why: Extends the existing getBudgetActionCategories eligibility filter and reuses getAverageBudgetAmount and getSheetValue for the new action instead of re-deriving them.

duplication.why: The category SELECT with the new #fixed and template CASE expressions is pasted into getBudgetData and five action queries (one of them a new copy for setLastMonthSpending), and the includeHiddenGroups: includeHiddenCategories policy object is repeated at each site.

placement.why: The exclusion rule is in the shared filter in actions.ts, but half of it (what counts as templated or #fixed) is computed in each site's SQL rather than in one query helper.

scope.why: Changes are confined to month-wide actions, their handler registration and tests.

maintainability.why: The filter is shared, but any change to how fixed groups or templates are detected must be repeated in six SQL strings.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action, including copyPreviousMonth and the new setLastMonthSpending, filters through getBudgetActionCategories.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated SQL is copied verbatim rather than reshaped; it is plain duplication, not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: getBudgetActionCategories gains two general rule clauses (group_fixed, has_template) and no new flags; all actions still use it, though each computes the two input columns in its own SQL.
